title: Niko's FAAH crit
description: This resource pack changes the usual crit sound with the famous FAAAH meme
body:
A player was once hunting pigs for food and thought "dude,minecraft is boring! i wish mojang changed the crit so-" but then a white beam emerged before him, and a genie walked up to him. "Thy wish was granted, my child" the genie said,before disappearing in the air. and the player received this pack.
So i present to you "Niko's FAAH crit"! this resource pack changes the crit sound and adds 7 variations of FAAAH with the 7th one being pretty rare with a 1.6% chance and lasting 39 seconds.
-  Why would you need to download this pack? FOR FUN, **_and for the balance of the universe._**
